content.short: Alfred provides compliant cross-border payment infrastructure for Latin America.
content.description: Alfred builds payment infrastructure for Latin American corridors, offering virtual accounts, instant settlement and the regulatory groundwork that fintechs and enterprises need to operate there. Monad's documentation lists it among onramps. Latin America has been one of the strongest regions for stablecoin adoption, driven by currency instability rather than crypto-native interest.
content.meta: Alfred provides compliant cross-border payment infrastructure and virtual accounts for Latin America.
